name: dev-core
description: Codex-native development entrypoints and orchestration for decision grilling, evidence-backed planning, resumable execution, TDD, review, verification, continuous learning, issue-driven development, test design, CI/CD and release design, conventions-as-guardrails, and external design deliverables.

interface.shortDescription: TDD, verification, review, and architecture workflows.
interface.longDescription: Dev Core packages Codex-native skills for planning, TDD, debugging, review, and evidence-backed completion. Substantial approved-plan execution uses a coordinating parent, a configured implementation model, and a separate reviewer. A centralized role profile and capability-checked resolver make model requests explicit; bounded handoffs and a delegation ledger preserve ownership and distinguish requested settings from runtime evidence. Hooks surface project state and block selected destructive commands. Offline regression tests and a reusable native-agent smoke fixture support validation; custom review roles remain optional assets.
defaultPrompt: Use $dev-task to draft a design and TDD plan.
Use $dev-grill to pressure-test a material decision before planning.
Use $dev-execute to implement this plan through review gates.
Use $dev-review to review this change with dev-core criteria.
